_note: The single source of fixed customer-facing text (CH-4). Every verdict screen and bot reply reads from here. Changing verdict wording needs a decision note in apps/web/docs/decisions.

confirmed.title: Sent by your bank
confirmed.body: {bank} sent this message to this number by {channel} on {date} at {time}.

not_confirmed.title: Not confirmed
not_confirmed.body: There is no record of {bank} sending this to this number. Do not click links, call numbers or share codes from it.

cannot_check.title: Cannot check right now
cannot_check.body: The check is unavailable. Contact your bank through its app or at a branch.

belongs.title: This domain belongs to your bank
belongs.body: {domain} is registered by {bank}. This does not confirm that a message is genuine.

not_confirmed.title: Not confirmed
not_confirmed.body: This link is not on a domain {bank} has registered. Do not open it or enter any details.

link.shortened: Shortened links hide where they lead, so they are never confirmed.
link.lookalike: This address imitates your bank's name.

calling.title: {bank} is calling you now
calling.body: Purpose: {purpose}. The agent will read this code aloud. Compare it before you continue.

not_calling.title: Your bank is not calling you
not_calling.body: There is no call from {bank} in progress. If someone on the phone says they are from your bank, hang up.

call.mismatch: If the caller cannot read this exact code, hang up.
call.mismatchMany: If the caller cannot read one of these codes exactly, hang up.

activity.heading: What your bank sent recently
activity.none: In the last 24 hours {bank} sent you no messages.
activity.summary: In the last 24 hours {bank} sent you {items}.
activity.linkNoneOne: It did not contain a link.

explain.heading: Why this might be a fake
explain.fallback: We could not find this message in your bank's records. Fraudsters copy a bank's style to get people to click links, call numbers or share codes. Treat it as fake unless your bank's app confirms it.
explain.action: Do not reply, click or call. If you are worried, contact your bank through its app or at a branch.
explain.aiNote: This explanation is generated automatically and cannot change the result above.

indicators.callback_number: Asks you to call a number
indicators.unknown_sender: Sent from a name or number your bank does not use

report.prompt: Report this fake to your bank's fraud team? We send a masked copy with long numbers hidden.
report.thanks: Thank you. Your report helps your bank warn other customers.

bot.welcome: Hello. Paste a message or send a screenshot of it and I will check whether {bank} sent it to you. Send CALL to check whether {bank} is calling you. I will never ask for your PIN, password, card number or one-time code.
bot.otpAdvice: For one-time code messages, check them in your bank's app so the text stays on your phone.
bot.screenshotUnread: I could not read text in that image. Paste the message instead.
bot.notEnrolled: This number is not enrolled with a bank on Gaskiyya.

safety.neverAsks: Gaskiyya never asks for your PIN, password, card number or one-time code.

intro.title:
Is it really
your bank?
intro.body: Check messages and calls against your bank’s own records before you click, call or reply.

message.title:
Paste it.
Share it. Know.
message.body: Share an SMS, WhatsApp message or link to Gaskiyya. Your bank either confirms it sent it to you or it didn’t, or Gaskiyya tells you it cannot check right now.

call.title:
A code only your
bank can read
call.body: When your bank calls, the app shows a four-digit code. A real agent reads the same code to you.

privacy.title:
Your messages
stay yours
privacy.body: Message text is fingerprinted on your phone. Only the fingerprint decides the result, never the words. To explain a result that is not confirmed, the text is sent once with long numbers hidden.

link.title: Sign in
link.intro: Choose your bank and enter your mobile number. Gaskiyya checks the messages and calls your bank sends to that number. In your bank’s own app you are signed in already.
link.enterNumber: Enter your Nigerian mobile number, for example 0801 234 5678.
link.cannotReachBank: Could not reach your bank. Check your connection and try again.
link.banksUnreachable: Could not reach Gaskiyya to list the banks.
link.noBanks: No banks are on Gaskiyya yet. Ask your bank to join.

check.placeholder: Paste a message or a link
check.fingerprintNote: The message is fingerprinted on this phone. Only the fingerprint is sent to check the message. If it is not confirmed, the text, with long numbers hidden, is sent to explain why.
check.inboxEmpty: Messages your bank sends to this number appear here. You can also share any message to Gaskiyya from another app.

result.rateLimited: Too many checks. Try again in a minute.

calls.howItWorks: When your bank calls, a notice and a four-digit code appear here instantly. Caller ID can be faked; this code cannot.

activity.footer: Built from what your bank registered: type, channel and whether there was a link. Never the message text.

settings.textStays: Message text is not stored. To explain a result, the text is sent once with long numbers hidden.
settings.unlinkBody: You can link it again at any time.

language.title: Language
language.set: I will reply in English from now on. Send LANG to change it.
language.options: Send LANG and a language: EN English, PCM Pidgin, HA Hausa, YO Yoruba, IG Igbo. For example: LANG HA
language.hint: Send LANG to choose your language: English, Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo.

banks.heading: Linked banks
banks.pickerHeading: Which bank is the message from?
banks.removeBody: Gaskiyya will stop checking messages and calls from {bank} on this phone. You can add it again at any time.

advisory._note: Fraud warnings a bank's named analyst approved (decision 0018). The warning text itself is the bank's; these are the words around it.
advisory.title: Fraud warning from {bank}
advisory.none: No fraud warnings from {bank} right now.
advisory.unavailable: Alerts from {bank} cannot be loaded right now. Pull down to try again.
advisory.callbackNote: These fake messages ask you to call a number. Call only the numbers on your bank's own website or app.
advisory.pushBody: Open Gaskiyya to read how to spot this scam.
advisory.botNone: {bank} has no fraud warnings right now.
advisory.botFooter: Send me any message that claims to be from {bank} and I will check it.

simswap.title: Your SIM changed recently
simswap.body: Your mobile network says this number moved to a new SIM recently. If you did not do this, someone else may be getting your codes. Contact your bank through its app or at a branch now.
simswap.unknownBody: We could not check with your mobile network whether this number moved to a new SIM. Do not share this code with anyone.
simswap.ussd: Warning: your SIM changed recently. Not you? Contact your bank now.

receipt.title: Check a payment receipt
receipt.subtitle: Someone says they have paid you? See if the money reached your account before you hand over goods.
receipt.referenceHint: The 30-digit session ID printed on the receipt
receipt.screenshotNote: The screenshot is read on this phone and never leaves it. Make sure every detail below matches the receipt.
receipt.privacyNote: Only a fingerprint of these details and the account it was paid into go to your bank’s registry.
receipt.noAccounts: Your bank has not linked an account for payment checks yet.
receipt.invalidAmount: Write the amount as it shows on the receipt, for example 25,000.00.
receipt.invalidReference: The session ID or reference has 6 to 64 letters and digits.
receipt.unreadable: No receipt could be read from that image. Type what it shows instead.
receipt.heading: Payment check

received.title: Payment received
received.body: {payer} registered a payment of {amount} into your account {account} on {date} at {time}.

not_confirmed.title: Not confirmed
not_confirmed.body: There is no record of this payment reaching your account {account}. Do not release goods yet: check your balance in your own banking app first.

cannot_check.title: Cannot check right now
cannot_check.body: The payment check is unavailable. Check your balance in your own banking app before you release goods.

org.cannotCheckBody: The check is unavailable. Contact {bank} through its official website or an office.
org.notCallingBody: No call from {bank} is in progress. If a caller says they are from {bank}, hang up.
org.explainFallback: We could not find this message in the records of {bank}. Fraudsters copy an organisation's style to get people to click links, call numbers, pay or share codes. Treat it as fake unless {bank} confirms it through its official channels.
org.explainAction: Do not reply, click, call or pay. If you are worried, contact {bank} through its official website or an office.
org.otpAdvice: For one-time code messages, check them in the {bank} app so the text stays on your phone.
org.linkLookalike: This address imitates the name of {bank}.
org.reportPrompt: Report this fake to the fraud team of {bank}? We send a masked copy with long numbers hidden.
org.reportThanks: Thank you. Your report helps {bank} warn other people.

official.title: Official contact
official.body: {org} lists this {contact} as one of its official contacts.

not_official.title: Not an official contact
not_official.body: {org} does not list this {contact} as an official contact. Do not call, message or pay it, and do not share codes with it.
not_official.bodyAny: No organisation on Gaskiyya lists this {contact} as an official contact. Do not call, message or pay it, and do not share codes with it.

contact.cannotCheckBody: The check is unavailable. Do not trust this contact until you can check it.
contact.impersonation: This imitates the name of {org}. Fraudsters use names like this for fake customer care.
contact.spoofNote: Caller ID and display names can be faked. An official contact on your screen does not prove who is on the other end.
contact.notAContact: That does not look like a phone number, email address, @handle or profile link.

apps.officialBody: {org} lists this app as its own. Install it only from the official app store.
apps.apk: This is an app download file, not an app store page. Apps installed this way can take over your phone. Do not install it.
apps.fakeApp: This app is not one {org} lists, but its name imitates {org}. Do not install it.

ussd.enterNumber: Enter the number to check, for example 08012345678
ussd.official:
{number} is an official {bank} number.
Caller ID can be faked. Never share codes on a call.
ussd.notOfficial:
{number} is not a {bank} number.
Do not call it back, pay it or share codes with it.
ussd.badNumber: That is not a phone number. Please dial again.

app.placeholder: Paste a phone number, email, @handle or profile link

licence.title: Is this lender licensed?
licence.intro: Check a loan app, lender, investment platform or bank against the licence lists that regulators publish.
licence.entryHint: Loan apps, lenders, investment schemes and banks

licensed.title: On a licence list
licensed.body: {name} is on the {regulator} list as {category}. This does not confirm that a message, call or offer really comes from them.

not_listed.title: Not on any licence list we hold
not_listed.body: We found no match on the lists we hold. Licensed lenders are listed by {regulators}. Do not pay any upfront fee.

licence.similar: This name is very close to {name}, which is listed. Fraudsters copy the names of licensed firms.

cannot_check.title: Cannot check right now
cannot_check.body: The licence lists are unavailable or out of date. Check the regulator's own website before you pay anything.

licence.sample: Demo data: a sample of the list, not the full official register.

bot.hint: Send LOAN and a name to check whether a lender or loan app is on a licence list.
bot.usage: Send LOAN followed by the name of the lender or loan app, its website or its app ID.

ussd.prompt: Type the name of the lender or loan app:
ussd.licensed: {name} is on the {regulator} list. This does not prove a call or message is from them.
ussd.notListed: Not on any licence list we hold. Licensed lenders are listed by {regulators}. Never pay an upfront fee.
ussd.similar: Not on any list we hold, but close to {name}, which is listed. Fraudsters copy names. Never pay an upfront fee.
ussd.cannotCheck: Cannot check right now. Check the regulator's website before you pay anything.

shield.settingsIntro: On Android, Gaskiyya can check calls and messages from your bank the moment they arrive, so you do not need to open the app. Message text never leaves your phone.
shield.androidOnly: Automatic protection works on Android phones only.

calls.title: Check incoming calls
calls.body: Set Gaskiyya as your caller ID and spam app.

dialled.title: Check numbers you dial
dialled.body: Gaskiyya warns you before you call a number that is not your bank’s.

overlay.title: Show warnings over other apps
overlay.body: Lets Gaskiyya show its answer on top of the call screen.

messages.title: Check new SMS and WhatsApp messages
messages.body: Allow notification access. Gaskiyya looks only at messages that seem to come from a bank, and only on your phone.

really.title: {bank} is really calling you
really.body: Call code {code}. Ask the caller to read it to you. If they cannot, hang up.

notCalling.title: {bank} is NOT calling you
notCalling.body: This number belongs to {bank}, but {bank} has no call open to you. Someone may be faking the number. Hang up and do not share any code.

cannotCheck.title: Cannot check this call right now
cannotCheck.body: Do not share any code. If in doubt, hang up and call {bank} on the number on the back of your card.

message.notConfirmedBody: Do not click a link, call a number or share any code from this message.

creditAlert.title: Fake credit alert
creditAlert.body: {bank} has no record of sending you this credit alert. The money has not arrived. Check your balance in your bank’s app before you release any goods.

otp.title: Your bank never asks for this code
otp.body: A one-time code arrived while you are on a call your bank did not announce. Do not read it to anyone. Hang up now.

link.title: This link is not {bank}’s website
link.body: Do not open it or enter any details.

number.title: This number is not {bank}’s
number.body: The number {number} in this message is not one {bank} lists as its own. Do not call it.

dialled.title: This is not {bank}’s number
dialled.body: {bank} does not list {number} as its own. Its real number is {official}.
dialled.reportedBody: {number} appeared in scam messages that pretended to be {bank}. Do not share any code on this call.

campaign.title: This matches a reported scam
campaign.body: {count} customers reported a scam like this in the last 7 days. Do not click, call or share any code.
